newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Vranitzky says to work for WestLB.
newsitem.headline: Vranitzky says to work for WestLB.

text.p: Former Austrian chancellor Franz Vranitzky said in a magazine interview to be published on Thursday that he planned to take up a post as consultant to Germany's Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale.
"Discussions with Westdeutsche Landesbank are in an advanced stage. But I haven't concluded anything because I must first complete my Albania mission," he told current affairs magazine News.
Vranitzky, 59, has been working on behalf of the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe as its envoy to Albania since his resignation as chancellor in January.

He said he would advise the bank on political developments but would not be working as an employee of the bank. Nor would he continue his activities in Europe, or take up a job with the European Central Bank, as was rumoured in media circles.
"I will soon be in my 60s and do not want to take up a totally new job abroad," he said.
